           only for keypair-from-seed).

The implementation is FIPS 204 final: crypto_sign_signature/verify are the
_ctx functions with an empty context (M' = 0x00 || 0x00 || M), hedged
signing (rnd from randombytes), which is what OpenSSL 3.5's EVP_PKEY_sign
with "ML-DSA-65" and no parameters produces and accepts.

Refresh: re-copy the same paths from a new commit, update the commit line and
the digests below, and rerun tests/mldsa65_interop.py (interop with OpenSSL
and every committed signed fixture).
